control-layer-stack.title: Seven control layers
control-layer-stack.description: Policies, repository controls, managed settings, network, content exclusion, budgets and evidence each answer a separate question, and none overrides another.

control-owner-map.title: Who owns each layer
control-owner-map.description: Each layer pairs an accountable owner with a configuring role, and the two often sit on different teams.

policy-delegation.title: How a policy is delegated
policy-delegation.description: An enterprise enables, disables or delegates a policy; only delegated policies let organization owners choose, and conflicts follow the reference.

repository-guardrails.title: Repository guardrails stack
repository-guardrails.description: Enterprise, organization and repository rulesets add up around Copilot pull requests, whose workflows wait for approval by default.

managed-settings-sources.title: Managed settings precedence
managed-settings-sources.description: Device management outranks the server file, which outranks the local file and user settings, while deny rules win across every source.

network-boundaries.title: Two network boundaries
network-boundaries.description: The corporate firewall controls which plan endpoints devices reach, while the cloud agent firewall covers only some agent traffic.

content-exclusion-scope.title: Content exclusion scope
content-exclusion-scope.description: Repository, organization and enterprise rules reduce what Copilot reads for different users, but known gaps mean exclusion is not a security boundary.

budget-evaluation.title: When a budget stops usage
budget-evaluation.description: Inline completions continue, user-level budgets always block at the limit, and spending budgets block only when Stop usage is enabled.

evidence-retention.title: Where evidence lives
evidence-retention.description: Agent sessions show 24 hours, audit events stay 180 days unless streamed, metrics arrive after two full UTC days, and local activity needs OpenTelemetry.

metrics-signals.title: Match signals to questions
metrics-signals.description: Usage metrics, the audit log, OpenTelemetry and budget alerts each answer different evidence questions, and organization totals overlap.

risk-control-matrix.title: Map risks to controls
risk-control-matrix.description: Each risk row marks its primary and supporting layers, and an empty row shows a gap that needs a control or an accepted risk.

layer-selection.title: Choose the layer
layer-selection.description: Ask what kind of requirement it is, who it must reach, whether users can override it and what proves it, then choose the narrowest scope.
